senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; נָדָה) (v. נִידּוּי) isolation, condition of uncleanness, esp. period of menstruation.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 64b">Sabb. 64ᵇ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 15:33">Lev. XV, 33</cite>) <he>בנִדָּתָהּ ההא וכ׳</he> she shall remain in her isolation (from her husband) until &c. Ib. VI, 5 <he>שהתקינה לנדתה</he> which she has prepared for her menstruating time. Ib. II, 6 <he>בנ׳</he> (= <he>במצות נ׳</he>) in the observance of the laws connected with menstruation; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 1:7">Nidd. I, 7</cite> <he>חוץ מן הנ׳</he>, expl.

<cite ref="Niddah 11a:31">ib. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>בתוך ימי נדתה</he> during the days of actual menstruation. Treat. Kallah beg. <he>נ׳ שלא טבלה</he> a woman after menstruation before she has taken the ritual bath; <he>כנ׳</he> is to be treated like a woman during menstruation; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נִדּוֹת</he>.
Nidd. IV, 1 נ׳ are to be treated like menstruants; a. fr.—Niddah, name of a treatise, of the Order of Tohăroth, of Mishnah, Tosefta and Talmud Babli and Y’rushalmi (fragmentary).—

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:18">Ab. III, 18</cite> <he>פתחי נדה</he> the laws treated in <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:1">Arakh. II, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 8a">8ᵃ</cite>), v. <cite ref="Q02147"><he>פֶּתַח</he></cite>.
